_note: Web-only categorical chart palette; it has no counterpart in the app's Theme.kt. Eight hues in a fixed order (blue, orange, aqua, yellow, magenta, green, violet, red), one slot per entity, from the dataviz reference palette. Dark is unchanged from the reference; the light aqua, yellow and magenta are stepped darker (hue and chroma held) so every light slot reaches 3:1 on the light card surface. Validated with validate_palette.js against tokens.json paper.Vault: dark #171715 --mode dark, light #FEFBF5 --mode light.
